name: Sermon On The Mount
overview: The Sermon on the Mount reveals Jesus' authoritative teaching as He ascends a mountain to instruct His disciples and the gathered multitudes. It emphasizes the kingdom of heaven belonging to the poor in spirit and calls for a righteousness surpassing that of the scribes and Pharisees, warning against neglecting even the least commandments. Jesus also instructs believers to practice righteousness with sincerity, not for human recognition, highlighting the heart attitude required for true obedience and reward from the Father.
